question: Manika Batra won bronze medal in Asian Cup tournament. She is related to which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Table Tennis**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manika Batra** is a renowned Indian Table Tennis player.
 
• She has represented India in various international tournaments and has won several accolades.
 
• In the **Asian Cup tournament**, she secured a bronze medal, showcasing her exceptional skills and dedication to the sport.
 
• Manika Batra's achievements have significantly contributed to the popularity and growth of Table Tennis in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Table Tennis, also known as ping-pong, is a sport in which two or four players hit a lightweight ball back and forth using small paddles.
 
• The game takes place on a hard table divided by a net, and players score points by hitting the ball so that it lands on the opponent's side of the table without being returned.
 
• Manika Batra has been a pivotal figure in Indian Table Tennis, inspiring many young athletes to take up the sport.
 
• Her success at the international level has brought attention to the potential and talent present in Indian Table Tennis.
